_comment: InnerTube client profiles, tried top to bottom until one returns a playable
Opus format. Copy this file to data/youtube-clients.json to override it
without rebuilding: when YouTube retires a client, editing JSON is the fix.
'context' is merged verbatim into the /youtubei/v1/player request body, so a
new client needs no Rust changes. 'headers' likewise. 'needsPlayerJs' marks
profiles whose URLs arrive scrambled and require signature/n descrambling.
Probed 2026-08-13: ANDROID_VR and IOS return plain URLs with no 'n'
parameter and no signatureCipher. TVHTML5 and WEB answer UNPLAYABLE without
